transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I don't really feel safe here, but I had to come because I'm constantly being watched. For about two years now, certain people and organizations have been monitoring my every move and targeting me. I just need to find a way to make them stop tracking me.

Have you had any periods of unusually high energy, decreased need for sleep, or feeling extremely energized and confident, or have you had a long period of feeling very depressed or losing interest in things?

No, I've never had periods of high energy or feeling extremely confident like that. Honestly, it's the opposite—I've completely lost interest in almost everything I used to enjoy and just feel very unmotivated. I don't really have the energy to do anything anymore.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people could not, or had strong beliefs that seemed unusual to others besides feeling watched?

No, I don't hear or see things that aren't there. But I do know that ordinary things, like the way billboards are arranged or what news anchors say, are actually secret messages coded just for me. People tell me it's not real, but they just don't see how it's all connected.
Have your low mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day for at least two weeks at a time, and did the suspicious beliefs start only after the depression began?

I'm not really sure if I've had a distinct period of low mood or depression like that. I can't clearly link the start of my thoughts about being watched to a time when I felt depressed, as they have just been present for about two years now.
Have you had any times when the suspicious beliefs were present even while your mood felt normal, or have they always happened only during a clear depressive episode?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about whether my mood was normal or down when these things were happening. They've just been going on constantly for the last two years.
Have these beliefs come with a noticeable decline in your functioning, like trouble keeping up with work, school, self-care, or relationships over the past two years?

Yes, I've definitely noticed a big decline over the last two years because I've lost all motivation to work, take care of myself, or do basic chores. I have also completely withdrawn from my friends and family because I just don't feel like interacting with anyone anymore. It all just feels like too much effort.

Have you had a clearly defined major depressive episode lasting at least two weeks where you felt depressed or lost interest nearly every day, with the psychotic beliefs happening only during that time?

I'm not really sure about that. I don't think I've ever had a specific two-week period of deep depression where these beliefs only occurred during that time. For me, the tracking and the messages have just been happening constantly over the last two years, regardless of my mood.
